summary: A Discord trading group advertised high memecoin profits and persuaded the user to send 80 dollars worth of SOL. The group then provided a private key to a wallet displaying purported winnings and demanded another 2.2 SOL to cover gas fees before withdrawal.
user_mistake: sent funds to trading group based on advertised profits and fabricated member experiences
prevention: Do not fund trading groups that promise specific outsized returns / Do not send additional SOL to activate or withdraw funds from a wallet supplied by another party
